teaching.title: Introductory Programming Teaching Assistant
bullets: Assisted introductory programming lab sessions covering variables, conditionals and loops, and answered student questions during office hours.

projects.title: Calculator Module Testing

Wrote automated tests in Java using Git, and documented expected behaviour and regression checks for the module.

projects.title: Document Lookup Structures
